command:
npm install --no-save --no-package-lock playwright@1.56.1 >/dev/null 2>&1
npx playwright install --with-deps chromium >/dev/null 2>&1
node --test tests/web/agents-plan.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40
python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1 &
sleep 1
export OUT=/tmp
for t in ultra-board ultra composer-fixes; do echo "=== $t"; timeout 240 node tests/web/$t.cjs 2>&1 | grep -E '^(PASS|FAIL)|rror|all PASS|FAILED' | cut -c1-700; done
